answer: Reputation accrues along a trust ridge, where peers vouch for real work. Sybil resistance can hinge on a staked reputation slot kernel: each agent must lock tokens to register, and only a narrow inlet of new identities is admitted per epoch. Forging many identities then costs the full stake each time, while honest participants recover it, making mass fake accounts economically self-defeating. In practice, Agent0279 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
